# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 1 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-18

This log records all lines in 1QHa Column 1 where the three translators significantly diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 1:1 — "thought of truth" vs. "true thought"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "every-thought of-truth" | Preserves Hebrew construct: machshevet emet |
| LOGOS | "every true thought" | English attributive more natural |
| PNEUMA | "every true thought" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "every true thought" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). The construct chain functions as an attributive in Hebrew.

---

## 1:4 — "son of man" vs. "human beings"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-son-of-man" | Literal ben-adam |
| LOGOS | "the son of man" | Preserves Hebrew idiom |
| PNEUMA | "human beings" | Dynamic: renders meaning |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the son of man" (LOGOS). Preserves the Semitic idiom and resonance with Daniel 7 and the Enochic Son of Man tradition.

---

## 1:4 — "stand before You" vs. "dwell before You"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "dwell before-You" | Hebrew yashav = dwell/sit |
| LOGOS | "stand before You" | Liturgical register |
| PNEUMA | "dare to stand in Your presence" | Adds "dare" for weight |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "stand before You" (LOGOS). PNEUMA's "dare to" is interpretive addition.

---

## 1:5 — "pinched-off clay" vs. "shaped from clay"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "pinched-off clay" | Hebrew nṣr = to pinch/nip |
| LOGOS | "pinched-off clay" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "shaped from clay" | More accessible |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "pinched-off clay" (EMET/LOGOS). The specific tactile verb conveys smallness and fragility.

---

## 1:5 — "his destiny" vs. "his appointed end"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his-destiny" | Compact |
| LOGOS | "his appointed end" | Precise: appointed by God |
| PNEUMA | "our destiny" | Shifts to first person plural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "his appointed end" (LOGOS). PNEUMA's shift to "our" is unjustified by the Hebrew.

---

## 1:6 — "thing formed from dust" vs. "thing made from dirt"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-thing-formed-of-dust" | Hebrew yetzer afar |
| LOGOS | "the thing formed from dust" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "a thing made from dirt" | "Dirt" more visceral |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the thing formed from dust" (LOGOS). "Dust" (afar) carries biblical weight (Gen 2:7, 3:19).

---

## 1:11 — "fountain" vs. "spring" for maqor

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-fountain" | Hebrew maqor |
| LOGOS | "a fountain" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "a spring" | More natural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "a fountain" (EMET/LOGOS). Maqor echoes Jeremiah 2:13 and Zechariah 13:1.
